title: An agent points at a pane instead of focusing it
body:
An agent can move keyboard focus with the MCP tool `focus`, and a pane program can do the same with the socket verb `focus` in `src/server/channel.rs`. Jack wants an agent to point at a pane instead, the way a person points at something and says "look at this", without taking focus. Nothing in decade-apps uses the `focus` verb.

## Proposal

- A new MCP tool `point(pane, note?)`. The pane's outline pulses in a slow, soft glow in `MAGENTA` (#A26DC9 from the Omarchy theme, restored to `palette.rs`). A note, if given, sits in a small pill on the outline's top line beside the zoom and pin tags.
- If the pane is in another tab, that tab's pill pulses. If it is in another workspace, its sidebar card or rail tile pulses.
- The pulse ends when Jack focuses the pane, or after about 30 s. A timer redraws only while something pulses.
- The MCP tool `focus` and the socket verb `focus` go. `docs/protocol.md` drops the verb.
